skills.detail: Deals a close-range attack with a Knockback effect that will decrease DEF while the skill button is held down. Reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active. Deals a mid-range attack with a Knockback effect after a certain amount of time has passed or after letting go of the skill button. You are able to move while holding down the skill button. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.

Moves long-range.
